objective: Reconcile raw Zenodo g/r photometry row counts and SNR candidate membership against all 781,602 Table2 objects, with explicit Table4 crosswalk and 55 complete-metadata controls.
previous_knowledge_consumed: Table4 crosswalk contains 730,184 unique Table2 Seq IDs; candidate set contains 741,786; candidate-only residuals are 11,602; published-only IDs are zero.
The four positive fields gmag, rmag, Per-g and Per-r select all 730,184 Table4 IDs inside the reconstructed candidate set, with zero Table4 omissions.
Across all 781,602 parent objects, 730,239 pass the four-field predicate; the additional 55 are the fixed four_field_only controls and are not in the reconstructed candidate set.

A pinned raw-archive audit of the 55 controls is PARTIAL: only one has g-band rows, 51 have r-band rows, and no control has both bands represented. Raw row counts match Table2 Ng for one object and Nr for 51 objects.
The 55-control report explicitly warns that row-count mismatches must be resolved before interpreting the apparent SNR failure.
The Zenodo raw fields are documented as SourceID, RAdeg, DEdeg, MJD, mag, e_mag and flag; g_flag/r_flag have not been proven equivalent to DR2 catflags.

change.proposed: Run a single-pass, checksummed scan of all 781,602 Table2 SourceIDs against both raw Zenodo archives. Count raw and numeric-valid rows, evaluate SNR formula and flag-policy comparators, and compare per-object counts with Table2 Ng/Nr.
change.scope: Research-only script, tests, workflow and evidence artifacts; no production selector, model, feature schema or baseline changes.
change.rationale: The 55 complete-metadata controls have missing raw rows in at least one band. A full-parent row-count reconciliation is required to distinguish SNR filtering from archive incompleteness or SourceID mapping errors.

expected_improvement: Verify all raw archive rows, member sizes, row counts, CRC and SHA-256.
Produce per-object raw/valid/SNR/flag counts for all 781,602 parent IDs.
Compare SNR candidate sets with the reconstructed 741,786 candidate IDs and the 730,184 Table4 reference.
Quantify Table2 Ng/Nr versus raw row-count differences by membership cohort.
Identify all discrepant SourceIDs for follow-up coordinate and image-quality tracing.

reliability.before: Dependency Audit failed for CVE-2026-114613 in msgpack==1.2.2.
reliability.after: Pending fresh CI; msgpack==1.2.3 is pinned on the PR branch.

correctness.before: Only residual and 55-control subsets had raw row-count/SNR diagnostics. The 55-control audit was partial and the full-parent raw count distribution was unknown.
correctness.after: Pending the checksum-pinned full-parent scan and object-level comparison.
correctness.evidence: The 55-control report from run 41367972395 has status PARTIAL; 54/55 lack g rows, 4/55 lack r rows, and none has both bands represented.

reproducibility.before: Existing raw audits covered bounded residual/control subsets, not the complete 781,602-object parent.
reproducibility.after: A deterministic full-parent workflow, pinned artifacts, archive/member hashes, and per-object output schema have been added; execution pending.

evidence: The Table2/Table4 crosswalk and 55-control artifact hashes are pinned.
The full-parent workflow verifies Table2, Table4 crosswalk, candidate set, residual set, 55 controls, raw archive hashes, member SHA-256, byte counts, row counts and CRC.
Zenodo flag fields are treated as diagnostic fields only; no catflags equivalence is assumed.
Image-level INFOBITS are not available in the Zenodo attachments.

root_causes: The 11,602 residuals have complete raw SNR eligibility but incomplete Table2 feature fields.

The 55 complete-metadata controls have no dual-band raw photometry in the retained Zenodo attachment; their exclusion cannot be attributed to low SNR until raw-data completeness and SourceID mapping are resolved.
limitations: The 55-control raw audit is partial and dates from 2026-11-02.
Missing raw rows are not evidence of low-SNR measurements.
The full scan cannot recover image-level INFOBITS from the current attachments.
An empirical exact match between SNR plus four-field completeness and Table4 does not prove the publisher's intended selector.

findings: The four-field complete-case predicate is necessary for all Table4 members and removes all 11,602 residuals from the reconstructed candidate set.
The parent-wide four-field predicate also admits 55 objects outside the SNR candidate set.
The 55-control raw audit shows no dual-band raw coverage, so their apparent SNR failure is confounded by missing raw records.
Table2 ReadMe marks gmag, rmag, Per-g, Per-r, gAmp and rAmp as missing when zero; R2 and log(FAP) zeros/negative values must not be treated as missing.

open_blockers: Run the full-parent raw reconciliation workflow.
Explain all raw/Table2 Ng/Nr count mismatches.
Verify SNR candidate membership at object level for all 781,602 IDs.
Resolve 55-control raw row absence and 14 residual row-count mismatches.

knowledge_carried_forward: Do not call the 55 controls low-SNR failures while raw rows are missing.
Do not treat zero or negative R2/log(FAP) values as missing data.
Do not infer official selector intent from exact count matching.
Do not change production selector or v0.2.0 baseline.
